name: Ulrich
bio: Archetype: Dynamo, Extra Action. ⌽ Deploys [Pulsing Field] at turn start if it isn't already active. Gains [Dynamo] and injects it into [Pulsing Field] to upgrade it at turn end. ⌽ Enters different channel statuses when using S1, S2, and Ultimate, increasing enemy damage taken, increasing ally Ultimate Might, and dealing damage at turn end, respectively. ⌽ Gains an [Encryption Key] corresponding to the current channel status at turn end or when reaching [Pulsing Field] Lv. 3. The [Encryption Key] will boost the channels' turn-end effects. ⌽ If a channel is already active and its corresponding skill is used again, inject [Dynamo] and gain [Ceremonious: Ultimate Might] instead.
